name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 11 – Am 25
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 11a. Welcomes the letter sent by several Member States expressing concerns regarding the evolving jurisprudence of the ECtHR, in particular as regards the perceived expansion of its interpretative approach beyond the original intent of the European Convention on Human Rights; underlines the importance of maintaining a balanced relationship between the ECtHR and the Member States, fully respecting the principle of subsidiarity and the margin of appreciation afforded to national authorities; stresses that the legitimacy and effectiveness of the ECtHR depend on its continued adherence to its mandate as defined by the Convention and the consent of the High Contracting Parties;
